The Ogre's Breakfast

The island orcs who captured Babur in their raid on the free hunters' camp have given him to a neighbouring ogre tribe. Such gifts soon end up in ogres' stomachs, and only Babur can make the key to the gates in the Middle Mountains.

Objectives

Go to the ogres' camp

Obtain the first key

Obtain the second key

Free the craftsman

Escort Babur

Babur must survive
